statement: Compute zone and space heating and cooling loads from the analytical energy model, climate and internal gains.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Heating and Cooling Loads

superiority: Run loads locally in seconds and show per-surface contribution breakdown.

statement: Create an energy analytical model and run cloud-based energy simulation for design alternatives.

superiority: Run simulation locally with transparent assumptions and no cloud wait.

statement: Set building type, location, ground plane, conceptual types, analytical space resolution and zone parameters.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Energy Settings

superiority: Show each default used in the analysis with its source value.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Changing building type changes the default schedules used in analysis.

statement: Generate analytical spaces from rooms or spaces with boundary conditions and volumes.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Analytical Spaces

superiority: Detect and fix bad gaps between spaces automatically.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Space volume equals the room volume within 0.1 percent.

statement: Create analytical surfaces from model faces with type, orientation, construction and openings.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Analytical Surfaces

superiority: Edit surface types in bulk with preview.

statement: Generate analytical openings for windows and doors with area, type and parent surface.

statement: Run a solar study from view settings that shows shadow positions for date and time ranges.

statement: Show the sun path diagram with date, time and project location in views.

statement: Display analysis results as color surfaces, diagrams or vectors with legends and ranges.

superiority: Interactive probing of values at any point.

statement: Add custom analysis results to a view through a framework with display styles.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Analysis Visualization Framework

superiority: Standard open interface for analysis plug-ins.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Custom result values show on the surface in the legend.

statement: Compute path of travel across levels between selected points and show the shortest route.

statement: Check mechanical duct systems for disconnected elements, unassigned terminals and size issues.

statement: Check electrical circuits for unassigned devices, missing panels and overloaded circuits.

statement: Run strength checks through a link to a structural analysis tool and review result overlays.

statement: Review warnings (duplicate marks, overlapping elements) in a list and select affected elements.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Model Checkers and Warnings

statement: Display all constraints in a view with temporary visibility to understand dependencies.

statement: Material carbon parameters (embodied carbon values) introduced in 2027 and used in schedules and analysis.

statement: Summarise embodied carbon per assembly, material and level using material parameters.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Embodied Carbon Report

superiority: Update live as design changes and compare options.

statement: Report area and volume computations for rooms, spaces and areas by level and scheme.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Area and Volume Reports

statement: Measure distance between two points or along an element.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Measure Tools

superiority: Persistent measurement annotations.

statement: Produce an interference report listing conflicting element pairs for coordination review.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Clash Detection Interference Report

statement: Check piping systems for disconnected parts, unassigned elements and flow classification errors.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Check Systems: Piping

superiority: Offer one-click fix suggestions for each flagged item.

statement: Evaluate solar radiation on surfaces over a time range and display it as a colour overlay.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Solar Radiation Analysis

statement: Compute illuminance on a work plane with electric and daylight sources and show the result.
